# Tushit Audi — Web Developer & Automation Specialist

> Personal portfolio and case studies for Tushit Audi, a web developer and automation specialist building high-performance web applications, n8n workflow automations, SaaS platforms, and mobile apps. Based in Hubli, India, available globally.

Tushit builds production-grade software using AI-assisted development and workflow automation, and leads The Talisman, an AI automation agency.

## Work

- [The Talisman Coffee — Cafe Manager Dashboard](https://tushitaudi.com/work/talisman-coffee.html): Case study for a cafe operations dashboard concept.
- [The Talisman — AI Automation Agency](https://the-talisman-v02.vercel.app): Lead-capture landing page offering a free Automation Audit.
